{{Quote|Looking to move ahead with a new speeder bike? These are the best in the galaxy! Feel free to look around!|5WO-OP|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''5WO-OP''' was a [[GL-916's model/Legends|vendor droid]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The droid sold [[Speeder bike/Legends|Speeder bikes]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid's name is a reference to the word "swoop".
